name: When is it better to replace door casing instead of repairing it?

mainEntity.name: When is it better to replace door casing instead of repairing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacement is generally recommended over repair when the door casing exhibits extensive damage that compromises its structural integrity or aesthetic beyond simple fixes. This includes severe water damage leading to rot or extensive swelling, significant pest infestation (like termites), or large sections that are cracked, split, or missing. If the cost of repairing multiple large areas approaches or exceeds the cost of a full replacement, or if matching an old, discontinued profile is impossible, replacement becomes the more practical and cost-effective solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace casing when damage is extensive, such as severe rot, pest infestation, or large cracks. Replacement is also advisable if repair costs exceed new installation or matching profiles is difficult.
